title: BillboardGui
summary: 2D GUI that faces the camera and attaches to a 3D object (Adornee): name tags, health bars over heads, floating damage numbers.

properties.name: Adornee
properties.description: The object it attaches to (defaults to Parent). Use studs offset via StudsOffset.

properties.name: Size
properties.description: Mix of scale and OFFSET studs — offset units are world studs for billboards.

properties.name: StudsOffset / StudsOffsetWorldSpace
properties.description: Position offset from the adornee in studs.

properties.name: MaxDistance
properties.description: Hide beyond this many studs from the camera.

properties.name: LightInfluence / Brightness
properties.description: How world lighting affects the gui.

explanation.whatItIs: A screen-aligned card pinned to a 3D object — it follows the object around the world while always facing the player's camera.
explanation.whyItExists: Overhead names, boss health bars, and pickup labels need UI that lives IN the world.
whenToUse: NPC name plates and health bars
Interaction hints above objects (pair with ProximityPrompt)
tips: StudsOffsetWorldSpace ignores part rotation — predictable overhead placement
MaxDistance keeps distant billboards from cluttering
Billboards replicate: server-created ones show to everyone
commonMistakes: Size in scale-only units — offset components are studs; oversized billboards
Forgetting Adornee when parenting elsewhere — it attaches to its Parent by default
Performance: hundreds of billboards with AlwaysOnTop get expensive

examples.title: Name tag over an NPC
examples.code:
local npc = workspace.NPC
local head = npc:FindFirstChild("Head")

local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
billboard.Adornee = head
billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 30)
billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
billboard.Parent = head

local name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
name.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
name.Text = "Guard Lv. 5"
name.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
name.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
name.Parent = billboard
